destination.fixable: next-batch fix surface candidate (not a conversion promise)

unknown_fields.note: No row is class/destination unknown. Missing-node reference identity is proxied by the strict matched candidate state; no reference structure text is read or emitted. Chemistry of real byproducts is not adjudicated here.

conversion_expectation.note: No candidate-level gold evidence; 53 is a pool count, not a promised conversion. Full-switch upper bound +53 is an upper bound only.
